scope: Checked-in Python policy catalog. Grammar admission and optional all-fixture matching parity; not production replacement certification.
unverified: Policy scope, violation enumeration/rendering, fixes and suppression.

Complete-job batching across all grammars and the 100-execution budget.
A matching fixture is not proof that every semantic branch has positive and negative coverage.
